legilux|luxembourg/national/acts.note: Legilux lists 9,270 laws and the Constitution: 8,070 in force or not yet in force (the census), 1,200 no longer in force (431 in this repository's history, 765 listed in data/actes/loi.csv, 0 neither); not counted as gaps (README: What it does not show): 897 laws in force Legilux has only as scanned Mémorial pages (no XML) and 266 laws in force about named private persons (adopted since 1926), each listed in data/actes/loi.csv with metadata and link, not as text; Legilux's 142,634 acts of other kinds (43,816 Mémorial B publications, 33,351 communal regulations, 15,404 règlements grand-ducaux, 12,779 arrêtés ministériels, ...) are outside this corpus's text (corpus.json: the Constitution and the laws); the repository lists part of them with metadata and link in data/actes/ (PLAN.md); not compared in this check; first check: Legilux's list was recorded as the baseline for the next check
